'''Binoculars''' were a type of hand-held device used to view objects at a distance. The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] used a pair of binoculars during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] also used binoculars among their equipment during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

Other types of binoculars included [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] and [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].
